title: Heliobane - Cinder Crown
message:
HELIOBANE - Stage 4: Cinder Crown. E minor chip metal, 175 BPM, speed 6.
Gallop riff, twin-lead chorus, low-E breakdown with anvils, sweep solo, chorus up a whole step.
All samples synthesized. Source: songs/heliobane_stage4.gen.js (MUSIC-B)

patterns.name: R2 - riff, double kick, full sweeps
K2 - chorus in F# minor, to C#
turn - C D B, stop-time, fill
